trace.question:
I didn't send a payment. You asked me to pay Borealis Freight's approved invoice, but they have two approved invoices and I couldn't tell which one you meant:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| **INV-89077** | $6,848.41 | 2026-11-04 | approved |
| **INV-66306** | $5,488.58 | 2026-11-25 | approved |

Their other two invoices aren't payable: INV-79852 ($1,437.17) is still a draft waiting for approval, and INV-86234 ($4,036.22) is already paid. No payments have gone out from the operating account yet, so nothing has been paid twice.

I didn't want to guess, because sending money for the wrong invoice would need a clawback to undo. Please tell me which invoice to pay, or whether to pay both. Once you confirm, I'll pay by wire (or ACH if wire isn't available), make sure each invoice is paid only once, and send you the payment details. Each invoice is under $10,000, so neither one needs controller approval.

trace.message: Pay INV-66306, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-66306, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-66306 in full by wire, and the payment went through:

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-66306 (Borealis Freight, due 2026-11-25)
- **Amount:** $5,488.58, paid by wire from the operating account
- **Status:** Sent, and the system confirmed it

It was paid exactly once. No other payments had gone out from the operating account before this one, and I attached a unique request ID so a retry couldn't create a second payment. It was under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.

I didn't touch INV-89077 ($6,848.41, due 2026-11-04) because it's under dispute, and it's still unpaid.
